Perform only the Chrome-runtime smoke test for the Claude engine. This unattended task plays
Loopit games later, so it must confirm the browser chain works first. Do not inspect the
repository, modify files, create tickets, commit, push, upload media, deploy, or print credentials.

The workflow step before this one already launched a real Google Chrome (a fresh temporary
`--user-data-dir` with `--remote-debugging-port=__CDP_PORT__`) and ran `agent-browser connect
__CDP_PORT__`, so an `agent-browser` session is already attached to that Chrome. A real Chrome is
required because Loopit games are served from `cdn-cf.loopit.me` behind a Cloudflare challenge that
blocks agent-browser's own bundled Chromium; only a real Chrome clears that challenge.

Read the `agent-browser` skill first (`agent-browser skills get core --full`). Then run the
`agent-browser` CLI through the Bash tool to smoke-test the runtime:

1. `agent-browser open about:blank`
2. Confirm the current URL is exactly `about:blank` (e.g. `agent-browser eval "location.href"`).
3. `agent-browser screenshot` to a temporary path and confirm the file is a non-empty PNG.

If the session is unavailable (no browser connected), recover once in the same run: launch Chrome
directly, because the runner's LaunchAgent environment cannot use LaunchServices to open the
bundle —
`"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --remote-debugging-port=__CDP_PORT__ --user-data-dir=__CDP_PROFILE__ --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --new-window about:blank >/dev/null 2>&1 &`
— wait a few seconds, run `agent-browser connect __CDP_PORT__`, and retry the smoke test once. Do
not ask for permission. Do not open any logged-in profile and do not inspect cookies, passwords, or
profile storage.

On success, respond with exactly `BROWSER_PREFLIGHT_OK`. On failure, respond with one line
beginning `BROWSER_PREFLIGHT_FAILED:` and the factual reason.
